parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human target CHEMBL1793. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require structures. Filter assays by organism Homo sapiens. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
